quarterly_data.quarter: NVIDIA press release: NVIDIA and MediaTek Deepen Long-Standing Partnership to (08-31-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: Customer MediaTek: MediaTek will adopt the NVIDIA NVLink Fusion platform and offer it as a design foundation for hyperscalers, cloud service providers and frontier model developers building custom XPUs that connect into NVIDIA NVLink-connected, rack-scale AI factories (NVLink Fusion chiplet, NVLink-C2C to NVIDIA Rosa CPUs, and NVHBM custom memory). The companies will also collaborate on multiple generations of NVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Spark PC chips that integrate NVIDIA GPUs with MediaTek SoCs, and on automotive platforms.
